reviews.comment: Overall, a great professor. His feedback on his quizzes is good, which prepares you for exams. Make sure you understand the homework, since he pulls problems from it and adds a bit of a twist to quizzes and exams. His lectures are also very straightforward, and he posts them on Canvas.  Lastly, attendance is a grade (2%).

The undisputed goat of statics. The only downsides are that his lectures are boring and attendance is graded. They are 2 tests, a Final and 2 quizzes,  which are more than doable if you pay attention to the lectures and homework's as most of the questions are sourced from them. He tries his best to teach his students and is very caring, TAKE HIM!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are 3 exams and 2 quizzes, mostly free response but there are multiple choice conceptual questions, make sure you study that material as well. Completed slides are posted after each unit is finished. Turn in assignments are tedious but some credit is given if you dont have proper format. Free response questions all come from the textbook.

Not the greatest professor. Attendance is mandatory, and lectures are painfully long and drawn out. He makes "templates" for his slides that you have to fill out in class, and he won't post the complete slides until right before the exam. He's a fair professor, with three exams, two quizzes, and an extra quiz because we fully cover a subject.

Quintero has uses slides that are expository and comprehensive, but he only releases the annotated slides right before an exam. He also takes attendance each class to give points back at the end of the year. For these reasons, it would be wise to attend class. He is dull and boring. Hard class, poor spirit, but you know what is expected of you.

Pretty good professor. Topics are tough but manages to make them understandable. 3 exams, attendance is mandatory, and two quizzes. conceptual stuff come from notes that you fill out in class so be ready to take notes. Overall, fair grader and helps with what the test will be about and cares about his students for curves when needed.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was anxious most of the semester because of my D for the third of the semester, but I went to office hours, where I was helped, and went to the TA. The final replaced the lowest of my test grade, which allowed me to pass. The hard work was worth it in the end. Quintero is helpful. Even if you're struggling, he is not there to fail you. Gig Em!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attendance is worth 4% of your overall grade. This is the only motivation to attend lectures as the lecture is composed of effectively screenshots from the textbook orated by someone either uninterested or unaware of the material. He will not call on you if you have a question, he will get frustrated if you "interrupt" him to ask. Tests are easy.

If you can take someone else you should. He rarely uses anything digital and has bland notes. He tends to mumble and get confused in class. You'll end up learning more on YouTube than in his lectures. Rather mean but will try to help if it's easy for him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Would take Quintero for every structural class possible. He is a serious professor yet quirky and funny at times. His lecture material perfectly summarizes the textbook and that translates over to the homework and exams. He makes very complex material easy to understand.

Dr. Quintero made a class that is feared by many engineering students simple and enjoyable. Lectures were enjoyable, 50 minutes of material followed by 50 minutes of example problems. Exams were either directly from the homework or from the lecture. Attendance was 4% of the grade, free points. Participation is highly encouraged. Quintero is GOAT!
He goes fast in lecture (and doesn't post lecture notes) because there is a ton of material covered every class. However the class is definitely okay as long as you do the homework.

He is a nice guy and I have respect for him. Unfortunately he is pretty quiet and can be hard to hear during lecture, sometimes his accent can also make him hard to understand but you will get used to it. If youre confused go to office hours as he is extremely helpful. His grading was very fair and tests also fair. Overall a solid choice.

Lectures are extremely boring and you have to work hard to learn anything from them. Basically, the lectures are useless. The HW is the same for all of the department. Exams are from the HW. Dr.F is quite nice when you deal with him face-face but in class, he is painfully boring and seems uninterested in teaching. okay professor, bad teacher.
